selected_policies.C01: Round 3 uses positive finite elapsed seconds and metric 1 / seconds; lower time scores better. Specification resolved; canonical implementation tests open.
selected_policies.C02: Shared mapping DD=4, CA=3, BB=2; unknown classes block scoring. Specification resolved; implementation/parity tests open.
selected_policies.C03: Retire/hide S10:S12 from participant controls, preserve historical cells; verify zero effect in canonical implementation.
selected_policies.C04: Retire/hide Round 4 F8 control, preserve historical cell; Rounds 1–3 pool use stays unchanged.
selected_policies.C05: No public-facing H12/dollar estimate by default. H12 remains internal historical QA; future display requires verified basis and separate approval.
selected_policies.C06: Freeze ordinary rules after start; prospective-only changes to unplayed games; emergency changes documented with scope/authorizer/time/evidence and never rewrite completed results.

source_conflict_dispositions.Pilot armor mode: Use verified 10-minute Standard Battle only by default; omit the special Ocean mode until the exact current-client label is confirmed.
source_conflict_dispositions.Recurring Race: Treat Race as a separate side-event on weeks 3,6,9 and finale if 12 weeks is adopted. Big Race in the map table is a map name. Needs organizer ratification and dated schedule.
source_conflict_dispositions.Recurring team/bot composition: Later stages use equal 6- or 9-slot teams with 2–3 humans per side and bots filling slots. Round 1 2v6 wording remains a blocking roster sign-off.
source_conflict_dispositions.Allowed/banned ships: Use a published explicit allowlist; unlisted ships are not approved. List must be filled before registration.

match_outcome_rule: Verified match outcome is calculated from published individual-performance metrics (including Damage and Kills) under the approved scoring method; the verified outcome governs bracket advancement, with published tie-breaks applied where needed. governing_match_outcome_rule: Individual-performance metrics including Damage and Kills feed the approved scoring method to calculate the verified match outcome; that outcome governs bracket advancement under published tie-break rules. Implementation is unverified.
